Read the card's full body and every comment yourself through REST (`curl -sS "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/NNNNN" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`, every page); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-27420` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27420 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Filed p2 `domain:ui` `area:ai` (filing gate ① reproduced at 1024×768, zh-CN). The card leaves the degrade shape to the seat ("The seat picks"). **Seat pick: reuse the phone path.** When the split container is narrower than `CHAT_PANE_MIN_WIDTH + CHAT_PREVIEW_MIN_WIDTH` (780 px), the page behaves as it does on a phone (#2481): the chat keeps the full width, the preview is offered by the existing pill row above the composer, and opening it shows the existing full-surface overlay (`ai-chat-mobile-canvas`) with its close returning to the chat. At or above 780 px nothing changes (beside-chat split, draggable divider). No new chat/preview toggle widget and no change to the dock's own width or the list page: one rule, one existing presentation. Acceptance: no part of the preview is clipped at a 1024 px window with the dock open, and the full-page `/ai` chat at desktop widths keeps its split.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure on `origin/main` after `3bfb357a`; disproof welcome)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` ~:562–564 `CHAT_PANE_MIN_WIDTH = 360`, `CHAT_PREVIEW_MIN_WIDTH = 420`; ~:573 `clampChatPaneWidth` floors at `min`, so below 780 px the chat stays 360 px and the `shrink-0` chat column (~:2542 `style={desktopSplit ? { width: split.width } : undefined}`) pushes `LiveCanvas` (`LiveCanvas.tsx:128`, `flex-1`) past the container edge.
- ~:2466 `desktopSplit = canvasApp !== null && !isMobile` and ~:2490 `mobilePreviewAvailable = canvasApp !== null && isMobile`, plus the `isMobile` reads at ~:2854/:2868 (auto-open) and ~:2930 (overlay): these are the switch points. Expect one derived boolean (narrow = phone OR measured container < 780) replacing `isMobile` at those sites, not a second layout.
- Measuring trap: `useResizableChatPane`'s `ResizeObserver` runs only while `active` (the split is open), so a width read that disappears once the page falls back to the overlay would oscillate. Measure the page's own root (present in both modes), with hysteresis or a single threshold read from the same element, and prove no flip-flop at exactly 780 px.
- The console dock mounts this same page (comments ~:2571), so the fix reaches the dock without touching dock chrome.

### Scope

File surface: `AiChatPage.tsx` (and `LiveCanvas.tsx` only if measured necessary), the existing `__tests__/clampChatPaneWidth.test.ts` or a new sibling pin, and one patch changeset `@object-ui/app-shell` + `@object-ui/console` (app-shell is private; its code ships in console). Pins: a test that renders the page with a container narrower than 780 px and an open preview and asserts the overlay path (no split column, pill offered), and one at ≥ 780 px asserting the split stays. If the repo has a geometry e2e harness reachable for the dock at 1024 px, add the card's layout check there; otherwise prove it once in real Chromium and record the measured iframe box in the report. Ablation: restore `!isMobile` at the switch ⇒ the narrow pin goes red. Stay under 250 changed lines.

### Tier

Quote `dispatch-gates --tier`. Expected none (seat ran it on both paths: no path-derived mandate). `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium`. `Clause-②: no` (no published surface moves; layout only). `Metadata-protocol: none`. `Fixes #27420`.
